content:
EkLavya Model Residential School (EMRS) NESTS has released the Tier-II Result for the recruitment of Teaching / Non-Teaching posts.

The Tier-II exam was conducted from 22–25 March 2026. The application window closed on 28 October 2025, and the result is now published with official links to the scorecard and result notice.

  • Online Apply Start Date: 19 September 2025
  • Online Apply Last Date: 28 October 2025
  • Last Date for Fee Payment: 28 October 2025
  • Exam Date: 13, 14, 21 December 2025
  • Exam City Details: 28 November 2025
  • Admit Card: 11 December 2025
  • Answer Key: 05 January 2026
  • Final Answer Key: 04 February 2026
  • Result Date: 31 January 2026
  • Tier-II Exam Date: 22 – 25 March 2026
  • Tier-II Exam City Details: 03 March 2026
  • Tier-II Admit Card: 19 March 2026
  • Tier-II Answer Key: 13 May 2026
  • Tier-II Result: 03 September 2026 Available Now

This recruitment includes 7267 posts across Principal, TGT, PGT, Staff Nurse, Hostel Warden, Accountant, Junior Secretariat Assistant and Lab Attendant. The detailed post-wise eligibility is available in the official EMRS notification and post-specific vacancies should be checked on the official portal.
